validation: Root reports targeted exit 0; final log inspected. No reviewer builds or source edits.

checks.represents_unique: Same read function fixes length from tail-head and every indexed record word; List extensionality and function extensionality prove equality of record lists. No occurrence identity is inferred from equal contents.
checks.completed_queue: Same supplied prequeue and actual completed receipt feed DirectDrain.completed_call; false returns original queue, SYSTEM true drops min(length,cap), user true uses exact quote-or-append userQueue.
checks.completed_append: Same actual successful nonempty user receipt supplies both completed_queue and DirectAppend.user_append. Returns queue appended with inputRecord and actual input logSeries pushed by anonymous target-address log with AppendDataSpec.record payload. No detached log or postqueue assumption.
checks.failed_checkpoint: Actual false-status Theta result invokes failure_restores_journal for exact input world and complete substate, hence input logs and represented supplied queue.
checks.choose_queue_and_chosen_source: Chooses existing existential physical queue witness from JournalInvariant. For exit, representation uniqueness aligns any supplied chosen queue with the invariant witness carrying source-width proof; deposit source requirement is True.
checks.chosen_frame_and_mono: Frame transports same queue through exact persistent read equality; budget monotonicity changes no queue witness.
checks.transition_domain: All local drain fields obtained from actual pinned transition, supplied ChosenInvariant, explicit budget and calldata bounds; source width derived via uniqueness.
checks.transition_preserves: Uses same t.executed for completed_queue and same actual transition for JournalInvariant.protected_call, preserving explicit selected queue at exact after operation and budget weight.

explicit_premises: completed_queue: exact runtime code, DirectDrain.Domain for supplied queue/budget, actual completed receipt
completed_append: additionally non-SYSTEM caller, nonempty calldata, true-status actual receipt
failed_checkpoint: supplied prequeue representation and actual false-status receipt
transition_preserves: actual pinned Transition, ConcreteHistory.Allowed inputs, chosen pre-invariant and budget<2^128
scope_limits: No ghost occurrence IDs, fresh-ID allocation, injective byte-to-submission identity or global provenance theorem.
Successful local append logs and queue effects can be rolled back by ancestors; survival into committed transaction/block logs is not proved here.
Representation uniqueness identifies record-word lists only, including repeated equal records; it cannot distinguish equal-byte submission occurrences.
Global actual journal traversal must produce chosen pre-invariants, couple rollback checkpoints, and connect committed logs and queue order.
